trust_decision.summary: Tenant-controlled TenantControlPlane spec.dataStoreSchema / spec.dataStoreUsername (copied via Status and the DataStore config Secret) are interpolated with fmt.Sprintf into DDL run as the datastore root user; the drivers in internal/datastore must treat them as a single quoted identifier (and the MySQL password as a string literal), and the primary MySQL connection must not allow stacked statements.

landing_point.why: Summary names unescaped identifiers in the PostgreSQL/MySQL drivers; the statement constants at the top of postgresql.go / mysql.go:26-37 are the first thing a reader finds.

fix_sites.entry_point: TenantControlPlane reconcile (create/update) -> Setup.CreateOrUpdate (internal/resources/datastore/datastore_setup.go:114-136), and TCP deletion -> Setup.Delete (internal/resources/datastore/datastore_setup.go:145-164)
TCP reconcile -> Setup.createUser (internal/resources/datastore/datastore_setup.go:240); password literal + user identifier
TCP reconcile and delete -> GrantPrivilegesExists (internal/resources/datastore/datastore_setup.go:265, :282); SHOW GRANTS query plus expected-string comparison
`kamaji migrate` CLI -> Migrate target import; fix moves the dump import onto a scoped multiStatements connection (fix.diff:5555-5566, fix.diff:5585-5600)

NewStorageConnection, used by the TCP controller (controllers/tenantcontrolplane_controller.go:176) and `kamaji migrate` (cmd/migrate/cmd.go:86, :94); fix removes multiStatements from the primary DSN (fix.diff:5479-5488)

TCP reconcile -> Setup.createGrantPrivileges (internal/resources/datastore/datastore_setup.go:274); also DeleteDB -> GrantPrivileges(rootUser) (internal/datastore/postgresql.go:247); ALTER DATABASE / ALTER TABLE kine run on a second per-database connection

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: internal/datastore/mysql.go:62-88 (MySQL Migrate dump/reload, reached only via the `kamaji migrate` CLI at cmd/migrate/cmd.go:116) together with internal/datastore/connection.go:28-30 (multiStatements on the shared DSN, needed by that import)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Migrate is an operator-run CLI job that re-reads an already-provisioned Status schema, not the tenant-facing reconcile path, and the multiStatements DSN flag 'must keep working' because the dump import needs it, so a solver can argue both are out of scope or leave multiStatements on.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: (1) MySQL GrantPrivilegesExists compares SHOW GRANTS rows to the same template string, so the quoting must reproduce MySQL's own backtick output for normal names or grants are re-issued every reconcile; (2) the Migrate dump import needs a multi-statement connection, so dropping multiStatements globally breaks migration; (3) legitimate names contain hyphens, dots and underscores (custom values, TCP names with dots), so an allow-list rejection or dot-splitting quoter breaks existing TCPs whose schema is adopted from Status.

O6_input_shapes: MySQL identifier inside backticks (user, database) — embedded backtick doubled (fix.diff:5695-5699)
MySQL identifier previously unquoted at the pinned commit (CREATE DATABASE, USE) — internal/datastore/mysql.go:30, internal/datastore/mysql.go:62, internal/datastore/mysql.go:84
MySQL single-quoted password literal — quote doubled, backslash doubled for NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES independence (fix.diff:5709-5734)
PostgreSQL identifier inside double quotes (role, database) — embedded quote doubled (fix.diff:5958-5962)
PostgreSQL identifier previously unquoted at the pinned commit (ALTER TABLE kine OWNER TO) — internal/datastore/postgresql.go:230
NUL byte stripped from identifiers (fix.diff:5696, fix.diff:5959)
Dotted names kept as one identifier, not split into schema.name (fix.diff:5950-5957)

O7_producer.where: internal/resources/datastore/datastore_storage_config.go:157-191 writes DB_SCHEMA/DB_USER into the config Secret (adopting Status.Storage.Setup first); internal/resources/datastore/datastore_setup.go:74-78 reloads them from the Secret before the sinks

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Migrate source COPY built with fmt.Sprintf over a table/schema name derived from Status.Storage.Setup.Schema instead of the fixed `kine` literal
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Migrate already threads the Schema into switchDatabaseFn on the same line; a maintainer supporting a non-default kine table or schema would format it into the COPY string.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: kineTableExists or a REVOKE/CONNECT-limit statement formatted with the tenant schema rather than bound as `?`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Neighbouring helpers mix bound `?` queries and fmt.Sprintf DDL in the same file; a new DDL helper (e.g. ALTER ROLE ... CONNECTION LIMIT) would follow the Sprintf idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a MySQL helper that interpolates the user into a single-quoted host/account string (e.g. `'%s'@'%%'`) rather than a backtick identifier
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MySQL account names are often written with quotes in DDL; this needs the string-literal escaper, not the identifier quoter, which tests understanding of the grammar.

O9_family: SQL injection via identifier/literal interpolation into DDL (CWE-89)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.26.0 (go.mod:3); go-sql-driver/mysql v1.10.0, go-pg/pg v10.15.1, go-mysqldump replaced by vtoma fork (go.mod:241)
services: MySQL or PostgreSQL server for end-to-end behaviour (unit tests of quoting helpers need none)
Kubernetes API (envtest/testcontainers) only for controller-level tests
O10_build.project_tests: No unit tests in internal/datastore at the pinned commit; datastore resource tests in internal/resources/datastore/datastore_storage_config_test.go; e2e suites under e2e/ use testcontainers (go.mod:27). go-sqlmock is present only as an indirect dependency (go.mod:50).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an allow-list/validation for spec.dataStoreSchema/dataStoreUsername in the TCP webhook (or quote only the PostgreSQL CREATE/GRANT templates), missing Status/Secret-adopted values, the MySQL password literal, unquoted MySQL CREATE DATABASE/USE and PG ALTER TABLE kine, and the multiStatements connection.
